sql: WITH cyp2d6 AS (SELECT component_id FROM component_synonyms WHERE component_synonym = 'CYP2D6'), metabolism_base AS (SELECT m.met_id, m.drug_record_id, m.substrate_record_id, m.metabolite_record_id, m.pathway_id, m.pathway_key, m.met_conversion, m.organism, m.tax_id, m.met_comment, cs_sub.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure, md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name, md_sub.chembl_id AS substrate_chembl_id, md_par.pref_name AS parent_name, md_par.chembl_id AS parent_chembl_id FROM metabolism m JOIN component_synonyms csyn ON csyn.component_id = m.enzyme_tid JOIN cyp2d6 tgt ON tgt.component_id = csyn.component_id LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON md_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_par ON cr_par.molregno = md_par.molregno) SELECT * FROM metabolism_base LIMIT 200

up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for the enzyme CYP2D6. For each record, include the substrate canonical SMILES, substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion description, pathway key, and organism name.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs_sub.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name,
  md_par.pref_name AS parent_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism m
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON md_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_par ON cr_par.molregno = md_par.molregno
WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2D6'
LIMIT 200
